## History

James A originally lived in Scottsford, [New Brunswick](../codex/places.md#new-brunswick), where his sister kept house for him until he married his wife, [Emily](../character/emily.md), and took a fortnight wedding trip to St. John. After receiving a parrot named [Ginger](../character/ginger.md) from his dying sailor brother, James's refusal to get rid of the bird led [Emily](../character/emily.md) to leave him and return to her own home. Having eventually moved away, James was unexpectedly reunited with [Emily](../character/emily.md) when she arrived at his house, and he admitted to [Anne](../character/anne.md) that he was glad his long-lost wife had returned.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P1](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P3](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER V. ## Relationships

### [Emily](../character/emily.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/emily--james-a.md)

[Emily](../character/emily.md) is the long-lost wife of James A, who unexpectedly returns to his house in Volume 2. Following a period of past separation, James admits to [Anne](../character/anne.md) that he is ultimately glad to have [Emily](../character/emily.md) back. Their sudden reunion becomes a subject of intense curiosity and neighborhood gossip.
